steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I probably won't be found if I hide here...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But, I won't be able to go back to those kids anymore.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I hope nothing happens to them...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: *sigh*... Why...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you Miss Misha?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss Misha. I hope I didn't scare you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These are my coleagues, Franka and Liskarm.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey there.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Good day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're from Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. As an organization made to serve the Infected, at least...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We hope to be able to help you. That's why we'd like to talk for a bit.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Talk?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't the best place for that though...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As of right now, our top priority is keeping you safe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For the time being, we'll protect you, so rest assured.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What... are you talking about...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You're just going to capture me and lock me up, aren't you? !

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Get away from me! My claws are sharp...! If you don't want to get hurt...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Pfft.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What are you laughing about...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If we really were going to capture you, we wouldn't have given you a chance to resist.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Misha, we really do want to help you, so...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't trust you...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Lungmen treats the Infected worse than they treat criminals!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Why would you... Why would you go out of your way to help the Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: --Miss Misha, look...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What... are you doing?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Your...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Your hand...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You're also... an Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right, I'm just like you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are a lot of Infected in these slums. Those kids you left behind just now... they trusted you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha, you've already put them in danger.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Are you going to use those kids to threaten me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, I wouldn't. But someone has already started doing exactly that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We just chased off a group of thugs that was trying to threaten those kids.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lungmen is also currently searching for the Infected. If Lungmen found you first, it might've already been too late.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We wanted to divert the rioters from those kids by drawing their attention to you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Looking at it from another perspective, we'd also be able to keep you safe from harm.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Do you know why they're after me?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What reason do you have... to do all this for me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We actually don't know why there are Infected targeting you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we do care about the safety of innocents, including you. At least, this is the best course of action for the time being. I hope that you'll be able to trust us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Would you allow us to take you from here first?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Fine... Let's go.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: After all, I don't really have a choice, do I?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I wouldn't say that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But at least, thank you... Miss Misha!
